title: Human Horse
description: Say welcome to new Friend (Human Horse)
body:
![Human horse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c030ece0d2dbe2f68854401ad980642164b8d41_0.webp)!

Introducing the Human Horse mod, which will give you a new and simple experience with your new friend (the Human Horse).

You can find this Human Horse randomly in the Savanna. This horse is looking for a friend to protect and feed it, and that friend is definitely you!

Simply feed it Buger to tame it, and then it will become your friend, its purpose being to defend you from all monsters.

You can craft this Burger with one bread and one steak Like This BurgerCraft ![craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cd499db4fbea244bc1937f485f2de250bd5fd85.png)

Therefore, I advise you to have a new experience with the Human Horse and embark on wonderful adventures!! 

Right-clicking on it opens the storage.
